title: Oxva Slim Stick Kiwi Passionfruit Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Made for the Oxva Slim Stick Prefilled Pod Kit, these Kiwi Passion Fruit Prefilled Pods bring a bright, tropical flavour with no need for refilling or coil changes. Each 2ml pod is preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing up to 600 puffs depending on use. The flavour pairs the tangy sharpness of Kiwi with the rich sweetness of Passion Fruit, creating a lively tropical blend that feels both fresh and rounded. Built-in coils ensure steady flavour from the first puff to the last, while each pod clicks neatly into place for a clean, fuss-free swap. These pods deliver a smooth, discreet mouth-to-lung draw that feels familiar and consistent throughout. Each pack contains two pods, with more fruit, soda, ice and tobacco flavours available across the Slim Stick range.
